sessionRulesText: NORMATIVE PREAMBLE (pass-10 D-10.8, restated; fleet runbook is the source of record):
Off-screen/headless ONLY: test Chrome launches --window-position=-32000,-32000 --mute-audio (VERIFY muted+off-screen before any login; no sound may ever reach the 1070's user).
Interactive-session Chrome only, CDP :9333; match/kill test Chrome by --user-data-dir=C:\Temp\cdpwb-* ONLY; NEVER browser.close(), never taskkill /IM chrome.exe.

Tunnel (all three forwards or logins die): ssh -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -fN -L 9333:127.0.0.1:9333 -R 8765:127.0.0.1:8765 -R 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 young@100.127.215.75 (laptop runs serve.py :8765 + holtburger-wsbridge :8080).
?nosw=1 on EVERY URL. Fresh --user-data-dir per BENCH arm; eye items may share one session. Accounts single-login: >=25 s gap between logins or 'Account In Use' boots both.
__bootState gate accepts 'ready'|'in-world'; wait 'ready' before __set*/atmosphere helpers; confirm streaming via terrainBakedLbs plateau, not pose.landblockId.

Verdicts (CLEAN/DIRTY + notes,ts,by) are written back INTO THIS FILE (authoritative for eye verdicts) AND into docs/url-flags.md §0 rows; bench results go to RESULTS-v2 files with pointers recorded here.
Screenshots are owner-eye artifacts, archived with RESULTS, never pixel-diffed as evidence (PR-8).
Run validity: release wasm only (pkg/*.wasm ~4.5 MB; ~18 MB = dev = INVALID), serve.py --check green, bare-default boot loads with 0 console errors before any arm.

vantages.name: shift-boundary-walk
vantages.note: WALK (keyboard, real GPU) one straight run of at least 6 LBs from town into open terrain — the grid shifts in place every 2 LBs, so this crosses >=3 shift boundaries. Watch the leading and trailing grid edges the whole run. Repeat the same run on the OFF arm.

vantages.name: teleport-arrival
vantages.note: Anchor delta >= 6 LBs => whole-grid invalidate + amortized park drain. After settle (terrainBakedLbs plateau), sweep the camera 360 (az 0/90/180/270 at dist 40) checking arrival completeness. BENCH-TELEPORT is the CI timing arm; this is the completeness EYE.

vantages.name: sealed-hub-enter-exit
vantages.note: Sealed interior: grid freeze + amortized park drain + pinned return core. Enter, roam the hub ~1 min, exit through a portal back to the surface; watch both transitions.

checklist: Walk: NO seams/holes/ghost tiles at grid edges across every shift boundary (statics, buildings, terrain all present at the edge)
Walk: nothing visibly parks/vacates inside the view ring during forward motion
Teleport: arrival completeness — after settle, no permanently missing tiles/buildings/statics in the 360 sweep
Sealed hub: enter and exit both clean — no missing interior cells on enter, no hole in the return surface world on exit
Diag at session end (ON arm): __diag.residency() integrity counters pinLeaks/shiftMismatches/slotDesyncs all 0 (zero-tolerance)

Diag: pressure ladder r4Engagements — AMENDED per T20 report D4 (2026-08-09): r4Engagements > 0 is EXPECTED on the migration-era ?slotGrid arm (summed 3-instance wasm exceeds 0.94×M3 while the legacy shard cache is live by design until ST10); the ===0 zero-criterion binds at GATE-GRID scoring on a DEFAULT run, NOT on this eye item — score the other counters at zero-tolerance and record the r4 value
artifacts: screenshot per vantage per arm (walk: start/mid/end frames; teleport: the 4-azimuth sweep)
ON-arm __diag.residency() + gridLruDivergence dump at session end (archive with RESULTS)

vantages.name: holtburg-town
vantages.note: Town pass-membership pass: hunt known translucents (water, windows, foliage cards, particle-backed props) — the ClipMap item itself.

vantages.name: holtburg-floors
vantages.note: Depth-bias classes: look down at building floors/steps/decals from above — z-fighting shows here first.

vantages.name: shadowed-town
vantages.note: The receiveShadow generalization vantage (pass-10 debt row 38): buildings inside cast shadow — compare shadow reception on walls/roofs vs the OFF arm at the same sun angle (same session time-of-day both arms).

vantages.name: town-network-hub
vantages.note: Dense sealed hub: pass membership at scale + ENVCELL BAKED-LIGHT PARITY — interior lightmap look must match the OFF arm.

checklist: Pass membership: every known-translucent object is STILL translucent (ClipMap regression class); no opaque-pass leaks, no newly-transparent opaques
Depth-bias classes: floors/decals not z-fighting anywhere in the floors vantage
Shadowed-town: buildings receive shadows plausibly on the ON arm (coarsening acceptable, absence/acne/peter-panning not) vs the OFF arm
Envcell baked-light parity in Town Network: interior lighting matches the OFF arm (no washed-out or doubled lightmaps)
Silhouettes/winding sane at pool scale (no inside-out or missing pooled instances)
artifacts: screenshot per vantage per arm (identical poses + same time-of-day)
ON-arm class-census/diag snapshot if T22 lands one (pools count, classesCreatedPostBoot) — archive with RESULTS
